providers.title: A hyperbolic group that is not residually finite
providers.scope: There is a torsion-free word-hyperbolic group that is not residually finite.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Triangle complex criterion
providers.scope: If every nonempty cyclically reduced closed walk in every vertex link of a connected finite Euclidean triangle complex has angular length at least 2 pi + eta, eta > 0, then closed edge paths whose turns are all at least pi are not nullhomotopic, and the fundamental group is torsion-free and word-hyperbolic.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Metric preliminaries
providers.scope: The intrinsic metric of a finite Euclidean triangle complex is a compact geodesic metric; local geodesics consist of finitely many straight pieces, and their turns have link distance at least pi.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Diagonals
providers.scope: Every simple polygon with at least four vertices has a diagonal.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cross-cuts
providers.scope: A cross-cut of a simple polygon divides its inside into the insides of the two simple polygons it forms with the two arcs of the boundary.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Triangulated disks
providers.scope: Every simple polygon is triangulated by diagonals; every triangulation has v - e + t = 1, has an ear if it has two triangles, and the closed inside is piecewise linearly homeomorphic to a convex polygon.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Euler's formula
providers.scope: A connected plane graph with V vertices, E edges and F faces satisfies V - E + F = 2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Models of faces
providers.scope: Every inner face of a connected plane graph inside a convex polygon is an open disk, modelled by a convex polygon whose boundary maps onto the boundary walk of the face.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Counts of planar diagrams
providers.scope: A planar diagram has v - e + t = 1, its exterior walk has 2e - 3t steps, and every closed edge walk in it is nullhomotopic.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Edge approximation
providers.scope: A map of a convex polygon to a simplicial complex, along edges on the boundary, is homotopic relative to the marks to a simplicial map; every loop at a vertex is homotopic to an edge loop.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Reduced fillings
providers.scope: Every nonempty nullhomotopic closed edge path is the exterior walk of a planar diagram mapped to the complex whose interior vertices have cyclically reduced link walks.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Angular Gauss-Bonnet
providers.scope: In a planar diagram of Euclidean triangles, the sum over the vertices of (2 - n_y) pi - theta_y equals 2 pi.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Closed paths with large turns
providers.scope: Under the link condition, a nonempty closed edge path whose turns all have link distance at least pi is not nullhomotopic.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Torsion-freeness
providers.scope: Under the link condition the fundamental group is torsion-free, by shortest loops in free homotopy classes.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Thin reduced diagrams
providers.scope: Every geodesic triangle in every reduced diagram over the barycentric subdivision is delta-thin, with delta = 10(A + 1) and A = M + 2 pi M / eta.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Stability of controlled paths
providers.scope: In a geodesic space with delta-thin triangles, a path whose subarcs have length at most lambda times the distance of their endpoints plus C stays within an explicit distance D of a shortest path with the same endpoints, and conversely within 2D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Edge paths in diagrams
providers.scope: The edge distance of two vertices of a diagram is at most B_1 times their intrinsic distance.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Word-hyperbolicity
providers.scope: Under the link condition the fundamental group is word-hyperbolic: geodesic triangles of a Cayley graph are (4H + 2)-thin.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Punctured lines with few short cycles
providers.scope: Over F_q^20, for large primes q, there are punctured lines whose incidence graph has no cycle of length at most 12, almost every point lying on at least 4r^2 of them, with a numerical budget.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The links of the complex
providers.scope: The complex satisfies the link condition with eta = 2 pi / 5, and edges with the same label have link distance at least 14 pi / 5 at V and at W.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rectangular words
providers.scope: Every rectangular word g_iuv g_iu'v^-1 g_iu'v' g_iuv'^-1 with u != u' and v != v' is nontrivial.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rank under reduction
providers.scope: An integer matrix whose rows have norm at most sqrt(r) has rank modulo every prime q > r at least half its real rank.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The rank obstruction
providers.scope: No homomorphism from the group onto a finite group keeps every rectangular word nontrivial.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The group is not residually finite
providers.scope: The fundamental group of the complex is torsion-free and word-hyperbolic, and some rectangular word lies in its finite residual.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Malcev's theorem
providers.scope: A finitely generated group of invertible matrices over a field is residually finite.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Not linear
providers.scope: Every finite-dimensional linear representation of the group over a field kills its finite residual; the group is not linear.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
